highlights.headline: Germany news: Parliament approves fuel tax cut
highlights.summary: German lawmakers hope to drive down fuel prices by cutting taxes on gas and diesel from October 1. Meanwhile, Germany's defense minister visited Budapest to ramp up defense and military ties.

items.title: India news: Protests against election chief escalate as Gandhi, Cockroach party allege 'rigged' vote

items.title: Bundesliga, other top European leagues call for major FIFA reforms
items.description: The Bundesliga and three other leading European football leagues have said major reforms to world-governing body FIFA are "essential." However, they stopped short of calling for the resignation of boss Gianni Infantino.
